title: Conversation 2026-10-25: narrative practice as the default standard

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner asked to find the narrative-explorations process, then asked that it be available by default so agents act on problem and remedy talk without being told, then set the standard: one container per chat, browsable by day, titled and summarised by the agent, tagged by topic, the narrative being the initial semantic layer. This note is the conversation's identity record; the vignettes are the owner's words.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: Opened by Claude Code, 2026-10-25, as the first test of the convention.
